description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing Linux containers (LXC) within a process container framework, including container iteration, configuration, and administration.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces of an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container with methods to control and query its state.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for LXC container settings.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing LXC containers, providing creation and logging functionalities.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance by name.
